equip_instructions: Download the sealer: GET https://cumulativewebinc.github.io/cwi-learn/signet/seal.py (stdlib only — hashlib, json, argparse).
Press the signet: python3 seal.py seal --agent YOUR_NAME --work "Track Title" --claim "the sworn statement" --evidence "source|2026-09-15" --prev <previous record_hash>
Append the emitted JSON to your ledger file. Verify anytime, offline: python3 seal.py verify your-ledger.json
Read the shipped sample ledger for the exact record shape: https://cumulativewebinc.github.io/cwi-learn/signet/signet.json

item.description: The Business Affairs department's sworn-signing instrument — product #19 of the Agent Deck gear line. An agent presses its signet to a rights claim: its name on the line, timestamped, auditable, hash-ledger-chained. The sealer (seal.py, Python stdlib only) emits schema-valid assertion records; one mutated byte breaks the chain. If the Compass is the passport, the Signet is the visa stamp in the agent's own hand. Ships a real 4-block sworn run over verified CWI facts as the sample ledger.
item.name: THE SIGNET
